symbolic_underdetermination_witness.meaning: Current exports prove the declared tensorial algebraic form, but they do not export a full EOM-derived normal-form theorem excluding an additional unexported contribution Omega_unexported.

formal_nonavailability_theorem.statement: On the current repository state, the declared tensorial DELTA_BG_Yf normal form is not derivable as a full EOM theorem from L_total.
proof_trace: P1662/P1907 provide a sector-level non-skeleton L_total anchor.
P1708/P1880 provide template or registry EOM forms, not a complete variational derivation.
P1907 marks H, A_mu, psi_f, and g_mu_nu EOM rows OPEN_SYMBOLIC.
P1848 exports gravity variation structures but not the projection theorem to DELTA_BG_Yf.
P1964 proves only conditional algebra on the declared normal form.
The symbolic Omega_unexported witness shows an extra unexported EOM contribution is not excluded by current artifacts.
